Sim Funded Account Resets

Sim Funded Account Resets are live

Updated this week

**Note: resets are not available to Sim Funded Accounts that have had previous payouts.**

 

Ever crushed your eval, got funded, and then busted your Sim Funded Account before your first payout?

 

We've got your back! 😃

 

Introducing SFA Resets:
​

=> Reset your Sim Funded Account for half of the starting balance.

=> Up to 2 resets per account

=> No need to restart in an evaluation — pick up where you left off

=> Available anytime before taking a payout

 

Reset Prices (Launch and Propel Accounts)​

• 25K Propel – $750

• 50K Launch and Propel – $1,500

• 100K Launch and Propel – $1,750

• 150K Propel Static Growth – $1,000

• 200K Launch and Propel Static Growth+ – $1,500

• 300K Propel Static Growth – $1,750

 

Reset Prices Orbit Plans

50K - $599

100K - $799

150K - $999

200K - $1199

 

This is your second chance to reach that payout you were so close to 🚀

 

Reset your account now and stay in the game! 😎
